maddeler.e:
نضطرع (form VIII)
# نَضْطَرِعُ (naḍṭariʕu) /nadˤ.tˤa.ri.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِضْطَرَعَ (iḍṭaraʕa)
# نَضْطَرِعَ (naḍṭariʕa) /nadˤ.tˤa.ri.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِضْطَرَعَ (iḍṭaraʕa)
# نَضْطَرِعْ (naḍṭariʕ) /nadˤ.tˤa.riʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِضْطَرَعَ (iḍṭaraʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
